title: Compatible inverse image of profinite coefficient sheaves
statement:
Let $u:U\to V$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with small pro-etale sites and their universe convention [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and inverse image $u^{-1}$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let $(Q_n,t_n:Q_{n+1}\to Q_n)_{n\geq1}$ be a countable inverse system of finite commutative rings with unital ring maps, all in the chosen universe. For $T=U,V$, let $(Q_n)_T$ be the constant ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], equivalently the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of $W\mapsto\operatorname{Cont}(\pi_0(|W|),Q_n)$ with $Q_n$ discrete, and put $R_T=\varprojlim_n(Q_n)_T$, with projections $\pi_{T,n}:R_T\to(Q_n)_T$. There are canonical isomorphisms of sheaves of rings
$$
 c_{u,n}:u^{-1}(Q_n)_V\xrightarrow{\sim}(Q_n)_U,\qquad
 c_u:u^{-1}R_V\xrightarrow{\sim}R_U.
$$
Here $c_{u,n}$ is adjoint to the map $(Q_n)_V\to u_*(Q_n)_U$ sending each constant section $q$ to the same constant section $q$ on the base-changed object. The map $c_u$ is the unique map whose $n$-th projection is $c_{u,n}\circ u^{-1}\pi_{V,n}$; this canonical comparison is an isomorphism, not merely a map to a limit. These identifications satisfy
$$
 \pi_{U,n}\circ c_u=c_{u,n}\circ u^{-1}\pi_{V,n},\qquad
 (t_n)_U\circ c_{u,n+1}=c_{u,n}\circ u^{-1}(t_n)_V.
$$
They are natural in morphisms of inverse systems of finite rings and compatible with identities and composition of scheme morphisms, under the canonical identifications of composite inverse images.

proof.text: Naturality of constant-section maps follows from the two adjunction hom equivalences and the sheafification unit. The constant-sheaf adjunction to terminal evaluation, together with preservation of the terminal object under site base change, identifies the constant inverse-image comparison as an isomorphism by uniqueness of left adjoints. This argument works for arbitrary coefficient rings.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-finite-tower-limit] to the finite coefficient tower. The canonical limit.post comparison is an isomorphism. Every component of the coefficient comparison is an isomorphism by the preceding step, hence so are the corresponding diagram isomorphism and its limMap. Their composite is exactly the declared profinite comparison.

The projection equation is limit.post_π followed by limMap_π. Its uniqueness follows by limit.hom_ext. Transition compatibility is naturality of the coefficient comparison. Naturality in the tower follows after composing with every projection, using functoriality and finite coefficient naturality.

For identity and composition, first prove the finite constant-section formulas after the sheafification adjunction. Take their inverse-image adjuncts: conjugateEquiv and the unit of the composite adjunction give exactly the chosen identity and composition mates. Finally apply limit.hom_ext, their projection equations, and naturality of those mates to obtain both infinite-level coherence formulas.
